name: Nostr
author: tim
description: One Nostr bar chip: lock/unlock the local signer, compose and post a kind-1 note, review pending NIP-46 approvals, and manage relays/authorized apps. Also a compose-only hotkey overlay (SUPER + N) for posting without opening the bar dropdown.

barWidget.description: Compose a note, unlock/lock the signer, review pending approvals, manage relays.
